source.note: The reference is the KernelBench problem; the dispatch contract around it is what this tier adds.

target_environment.note: The task names the environment it was measured in and leaves the device model, architecture and component versions in that record. Latencies are comparable only within one snapshot_id.

tensor_contract.note: float16 and bfloat16 only. On the target environment the fused attention path does not answer float32, so a float32 run would silently grade the composition path and call it a dispatch result.

submission.note: KernelBench-style submission: a Python module defining ModelNew. The fused and composition paths call the whitelisted libraries; the fallback may JIT-compile a .mu kernel.

scoring.gate: every hidden correctness case passes and every dispatch trace matches the expected path
scoring.ranking: B-library track only; never merged or averaged with the A-kernel track

admission.reason: the hidden gap set, the naive-composition and expert-dispatch baselines, and the 1.3x admission gate are all measurements. None of them can be produced off the target device, and none of them are asserted here.
admission.dispatch_note: the problem is already written against a framework attention module, so the library path is the reference's own route

gap_reason_coverage.basis: §4.3 asks a task's hidden gap set to cover at least two reason categories; this task reaches one. layout_mismatch: the reference reshapes the image to (B, C, H*W) and permutes to (H*W, B, C) before attending, so the tensor the attention core consumes is sequence-major, not the BHSD the fused path is written for. The library cannot serve the task's own layout without a conversion, which is the dispatch decision. This is a structural judgement, not a measurement: the family probe only covered a non-contiguous tensor in the BHSD layout, which is a different case, so this reason must be confirmed on the device before the hidden set relies on it. unsupported_shape is unreachable because head_dim = embed_dim / num_heads is fixed at 32 by the problem defaults, and a non-aligned sequence length was measured to still dispatch fused. semantic_mismatch is unreachable: the scale is the framework default 1/sqrt(D) and there is no mask, so no row can be fully masked. multi_operator_required is unreachable: one attention op. This entry needs a second measurable category before it can meet the floor.
